title: Exercise for Knee Pain
subtitle: Evidence, mechanisms, practical application, progression, and safety considerations for exercise for knee pain
evidence_strength: Strong evidence supports the efficacy of exercise for reducing knee pain in osteoarthritis and chronic conditions, especially with combined aerobic and resistance modalities. Moderate evidence addresses safety and individualized progression, while emerging evidence relates to novel exercise technologies and personalized approaches.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
